## Investment Thesis
Babcock & Wilcox has a compelling clean energy transition story: BrightLoop hydrogen production, biomass/waste-to-energy systems, and industrial decarbonization. The forward PE of 20.2x implies ~$95M in forward earnings at 15.8% margin on ~$600M Y1 revenue — a meaningful profitability step-up from current loss-making status.

However, B&W has a long history of financial distress — the company underwent restructuring and near-bankruptcy in 2019-2020. Debt remains elevated. The 2% TTM revenue growth suggests the legacy boiler business is declining faster than clean energy is growing. There is execution risk on BrightLoop hydrogen contracts, which remain in pilot phase.

Our DCF uses a conservative base of 10% CAGR (below the forward PE-implied trajectory) and 10% terminal margin (below the 15.8% forward margin), resulting in $8.83 FV. The prior Gemini analysis assigned BUY $27.13 — this required aggressive growth assumptions (~15-25% CAGR) without penalizing for balance sheet risk. We disagree: at $14.07, the market is already pricing in successful clean energy execution, leaving no margin of safety.

SELL at current price. Would reconsider at $8-9 range.
